errors.evidence: The vertical axis is not labeled in the figure; the label "值" (value) is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: 图表包含10个灰色的柱状图，每个柱状图代表一次实验的结果。
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart containing 10 groups of 2 bars each, for a total of 20 bars. The description incorrectly states there are only 10 bars.
The description fails to mention the grouped nature of the bars and omits the legend, which distinguishes the two data series: '30个模型结果的均值' (light gray) and '30个模型的投票结果' (dark gray).

errors.text_span: 柱状图高度近似相等，在70-75之间波动，例如第一个柱状图高度约为71，最后一个柱状图高度约为74。
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly combines the two distinct data series into one. The light gray bars are all around a value of 70-71, while the dark gray bars are all around a value of 75. The example values given for the first and last bars are taken from different series (the light gray bar in group 1 and the dark gray bar in group 10).
